purpose: Re-read with no new fit: the LIRF masked member M (lm25_32, the 16 seeds 801-816 of configs/adsb_ctx3_lirf_mask_dev_v1.json, shipped in v53/v54 on unmatched rows only) blended into the shipped LIRF network on LIRF's non-population rows WITH an ADS-B match: network' = (1 - w) ens_ctx_lirf + w M, read inside v34's matched blend (v9 0.15 / network 0.40 / tree 0.45) with v45's matched gate m600. This is the matched-row half of v51's combination member (a second network on matched rows, which v51 gained from outside LIRF) carried to LIRF with an existing network, so no fit is needed.

disclosed.design_reading: docs/adsb_ctx3_lirf/design_report.json (1 October, 4 design-fold seeds 21-24, transfer readings): lm25_32 alone on matched LIRF rows, network-only RMSE against the shipped family's four round-B seeds: October 370.79 vs 374.28 s, July natural 433.68 vs 436.70 s, December natural 283.25 vs 283.58 s. That reading (a different seed set and fold) suggested this re-read. The 16-seed development-fold member has never been read on matched rows: docs/adsb_ctx3_lirf_mask/results_v1.json and docs/lirf_dark/results_v1.json score unmatched rows only.
disclosed.v51: docs/adsb_ctx3_combo/README.md: outside LIRF, the combination member's matched-row network (dl32) gained by being different from the pool rather than by standalone accuracy; v51 = 222.2306 official (-0.374 s against v48). Recorded as the motivation only; no official score steers the grid.
disclosed.grid: The weights follow the unmatched round's grid (0.25 / 0.40 / 0.55) plus 0.70; nothing else was tried.

inputs: runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet (v9, lirf_net, lirf_tree, label, day, lirf_m) and the 16 lm25_32 seeds per fold, exactly the files of tools/run_lirf_member.py: July 2025 = lomo_2025-07/predictions.parquet, November 2025 = forward/predictions.parquet, December 2025 = refit/december_predictions.parquet.

sets.natural:2025-07: July 2025 LIRF non-population matched rows (lirf_m, 13,992), eleven-month LOMO footing
sets.natural:2025-11: November 2025 LIRF non-population matched rows (lirf_m, 7,401), forward fold
sets.natural:2025-12: December 2025 LIRF non-population matched rows (lirf_m, 9,506), January-November refit: the month next to January 2026, the only ranking month with LIRF ADS-B coverage (8,747 of 10,950 non-population rows matched)
sets.not_used: January 2025 has no matched LIRF row; thinned July has 85 (not a set).

control: v54's arithmetic on matched rows, which v53 and v54 did not change: v34's matched blend on ens_ctx_lirf with v45's gate m600 (tree - network > 600 s: v9 0.15 / network 0.2 / tree 0.65), floor -12. Check before any candidate: each month's lirf_net on the set equals the mean of the shipped network's saved fold predictions (seeds 301-316) within 0.01 s RMS.
semantics: network' = (1 - w) ens_ctx_lirf + w M on the set; the matched blend and the m600 gate are recomputed with network' (the gate fires on tree - network' > 600 s).
metric: Primary: squared error of the set's rows with labels below 20,000 s, relative change against the control with a paired-day 95% interval (10,000 day draws, seed 20261002). Reported as well: the unfiltered change, and the route's SSE change as a share of the whole month's SSE at the rows table's v33 column (every row of the month; a scale reference, not the shipped stack).
rule: A candidate is eligible when (1) December's primary change is at most -0.25% with its interval below zero, (2) July's and November's primary changes are at most 0, and (3) no set's interval lies entirely above zero. Selection: among eligible candidates the lowest mean of the three primary changes. No eligible candidate: nothing selected, v54 stands.
expectation_scale: January 2026's 8,747 matched route rows at about December's matched RMSE (~285 s) hold about 7.1e8 SSE; -0.5% is about -3.6e6, about -0.02 s on 221.9 s at alignment 1. Small; read because it costs no fit.
never_read: No official score, ranking label or published aggregate.
export_plan: If selected and the user says so: v54's model part (runs/lirf_dark/export_dry/vigorous-whistle_v54.parquet, before the reconciliation) with the ranking's lirf_nonpop_matched rows recomputed from the refit12 member (16-seed mean) at the selected w: value = base + (candidate - control), floor -12; every other row keeps the base integer; then v48's reconciliation last (tools/export_daily_totals.py --base), audit, and a check that every other row equals v54's model part.
scorer: tools/run_lirf_combo.py (written before any candidate was read)
